methods.description: Line up equal place values, add trailing zeros without changing the numbers, and add each column with carrying where needed.
Line up equal place values, add trailing zeros where needed, and subtract each column after borrowing or regrouping across placeholders.
Find a difference by counting up from the smaller decimal to an easy whole number and then to the larger decimal; add the increases.
Use the relation between addition and subtraction to find a missing part; subtract the known part from the total or the remaining number from the starting number, then check.
